in_marathi.name: Sowmya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sowmya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sowmya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'maya' meaning illusion. It is an auspicious name that signifies being free from worldly illusions and material desires.
